subject: HelixAI dedicated capacity — price anchor, lane recommendation & bench plan
messages:
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@helixai.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-10T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelixAI - Dedicated capacity recap and next steps

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for the demo today — great discussion. Quick recap and the items we agreed to follow up on:

- Workload profile: Llama2-70B fine-tuned (chat + structured outputs), average prompt+response ~1.2k tokens, median session length ~900 tokens.
- Expected monthly consumption: scenario A 50M tokens/mo (pilot), scenario B 300M tokens/mo (launch), scenario C 900M tokens/mo (aggressive growth).
- Latency/throughput requirement: interactive SLA ~200ms p95 for short replies; sustained throughput for batch/generation bursts required.
- Preliminary hardware fit: customer prefers H100 for KV cache and lower quantized latency; we should validate on A100 as a cost alternative.

Attached: redwood-dedicated-estimate-helixai.pdf (starter pricing & lanes) and a bench plan draft.

Primary asks from Helix:
1) A clear price anchor in $/1M tokens for a 12–18 month reserved commitment.
2) Recommended reserved lane sizing and burst autoscale plan (H100 vs A100 tradeoffs).
3) A short benchmark run on their fine-tune to validate throughput.

Proposed next steps:
- We'll propose a commercial anchor and technical bench plan (Elliot + Marissa) by EOD Friday 3/12.
- Scheduling: bench run week of 3/22 if Helix confirms.

Thanks — copying Marissa and Ben to align on pricing and technical ops.

Best,
Elliot Price
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
elliot.price@redwood.com

Attachments:
- redwood-dedicated-estimate-helixai.pdf (pdf)
- helix-bench-plan.md (text)

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@helixai.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@helixai.com>
Date: 2027-03-11T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelixAI - Dedicated capacity recap and next steps

Elliot,

Appreciate the clear recap. A couple of clarifications before we lock in the bench: 

- GPU preference: our infra team is biased toward H100 for the 70B fine-tune (KV cache + quantized fp16 benefits) but we are sensitive to cost — curious how A100 would change the unit economics.
- Volume: 300M/month is the realistic BAU baseline for months 2–6; pilot will be 40–60M/mo. For runway planning, include a 3x growth plan (so designs should be able to scale to ~900M/mo).
- Throughput expectations: we need a sustained lane for interactive traffic (p95 latency target for short replies) and the ability to absorb bursty generation (reporting batch jobs). If you have an expected tokens/sec per GPU estimate for H100 vs A100 at our average 1.2k token response length that would be helpful.

Also please confirm the "price anchor" you mentioned — we want a simple $/1M tokens rate for an initial 12-month reserved commitment and then tiered pricing if we hit the higher volumes. Any suggested discount bands for 12 vs 18 months?

If you can send a short proposal and bench plan by EOD Friday we can try to align legal and infra for a bench during week of 3/22.

Thanks,
Sara
VP Product | HelixAI

On Wed, Mar 10, 2027 at 3:22 PM Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo today — great discussion. Quick recap and the items we agreed to follow up on...

From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-11T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: HelixAI - Dedicated capacity recap and next steps (pricing anchor ask)

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Sara's clarifying questions. TL;DR and my recommendation: 

TL;DR:
- Baseline volume: 300M tokens/mo (BAU) with pilot 50M/mo and growth to 900M/mo.
- Helix preference: H100 but wants A100 comparison for price sensitivity.
- They want a simple $/1M token anchor for 12–18 months + tiered bands.

Commercial anchor proposal (preliminary, for feedback):
- Anchor list: $525 / 1M tokens on H100 reserved lane for 12-month commitment (standard support).
- Commercial concessions: 15% net off anchor for 12-month upfront payment; 20% for 18-month upfront.
- Tiering: 0-100M/month = anchor rate; 100-400M/month = anchor - 12%; >400M/month = anchor - 20% (applied retroactively each billing period).

Technical lane recommendation (ops):
- Start: 3x H100 reserved lane (steady aggregate throughput estimate ~6,000 tokens/sec at our target 1.2k token responses, assuming continuous batching).
- Burst: autoscale to 6x H100 for short bursts (peak ~12k tokens/sec).
- A100 alt: estimate ~20% lower steady tokens/sec per GPU but ~25% lower unit infra cost — run bench to quantify.

Bench needs:
- 4-6 hour perf run using their fine-tune for the 1.2k token workload (we capture p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, memory/KV metrics).
- Ops: bench engineers (Ben) + model/bench request owner (Marissa) to schedule infra.

Questions for you both:
- Is anchor $525/1M agreeable from a margin standpoint? (I modeled a 25% gross margin at list price; discounting bands will reduce margin — we can trade term for margin.)
- Any objections to the 3->6 H100 sizing? I erred on the conservative side to ensure p95 latency targets for interactive traffic.

If this looks OK I'll send the commercial anchor and bench plan back to Sara by EOD 3/12 and propose bench dates.

Thanks,
Elliot

-- Forwarded message attached --

From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@helixai.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-12T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: HelixAI - Dedicated capacity proposal (anchor + lane sizing)

Hi Sara — following up with a concise proposal and bench plan based on our internal review. See key numbers below; full PDF attached.

Proposal summary (commercial):
- Recommended anchor (H100 reserved lane): $525 / 1M tokens (list).
- Committed pricing: 12-month term = $525 less 15% => $446.25 / 1M tokens (paid upfront option); 18-month term = $525 less 20% => $420 / 1M tokens (paid upfront).
- Tiered structure (monthly consumption bands): 0-100M = anchor; 100-400M = anchor - 12%; >400M = anchor - 20% (applies to actual usage each month).

Technical recommendation (lane sizing & throughput):
- Launch lane: 3x H100 reserved instances (steady throughput estimate ~6,000 tokens/sec aggregate with continuous batching at avg 1.2k token responses).
- Burst autoscale: add 3x H100 for short periods (peak ~12,000 tokens/sec).
- A100 alternative: expect ~15-25% lower tokens/sec per GPU at equal batch; cost advantage will show up in list price — we included an A100 appendix in the attached PDF.

Bench plan (what we will run):
- 6-hour perf run using Helix fine-tune with realistic traffic mix (70% interactive, 30% batch).
- Metrics captured: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, KV cache hit/miss, GPU utilization, and per-request cost estimate.
- Owners: Ben (bench ops), Marissa (model owner), Elliot (commercial sync).

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-estimate-helixai.pdf, helix-bench-plan.md (bench run checklist).

Requested confirmation from Helix:
1) Does the 12- vs 18-month upfront pricing make sense as a starting commercial anchor ($446.25/1M vs $420/1M)?
2) Can you confirm a bench window week of 3/22 and provide a test dataset (anonymized) for the perf run?
3) Any procurement/legal gating items we should surface ahead of time?

If you confirm the bench window, Ben will schedule the run and share a live dashboard during the test. Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call if that helps.

Best,
Elliot Price
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
elliot.price@redwood.com

Attachments:
- redwood-dedicated-estimate-helixai.pdf (pdf)
- helix-bench-plan.md (text)
